resources.string: Use the arrows on your remote to move, OK to choose and Back to return.

Choose a country, then a server. Selecting Connect starts the VPN after you grant Android permission.\n\nPublic servers are run by volunteers. Avoid using them for banking or other sensitive accounts.
DNS turns a site name into its network address. To change it, choose DNS from the home screen menu. If you are not sure, leave the default.
Choose L2TP/IPsec or SSTP from the Service card. Each service has its own list of servers. If one does not connect on your network, try the other.
